_meta.notes: Every visible string of the Legal form lives here (template via bin/build-site.php, legal.js via the #strings data attribute). formVersion is the single source of the form version (not in app.env): bump it whenever fields or validation rules change. limits are mirrored by legal.js; the server re-checks them (Prompt 4).

page.title: VEA Legal Assistance Request Form
page.noscript: This form needs JavaScript. Turn it on in your browser and reload the page.

banner.privilege: PRIVILEGED & CONFIDENTIAL – PREPARED AT THE DIRECTION OF COUNSEL

membershipNumber.label: Membership Number
membershipNumber.help: Enter all 10 digits, including leading zeros (e.g., 0001234567).

local.label: Name of Local Union
local.help: Changing the local resets the worksite.

requestedOutcome.label: What do you want VEA to do for you?

documents.label: Documentation
documents.help: Up to 5 files, 10 MB each, 25 MB in total. Allowed: Word (.docx), Excel (.xlsx), CSV, PDF, PNG, JPG and text (.txt) files.

issueTypes: Reasonable Accommodations under the Americans with Disabilities Act
Leave (including those related to the Family and Medical Leave Act)

messages.zip: Enter a 5-digit ZIP code or ZIP+4.
messages.dobFuture: The date of birth cannot be in the future.
messages.dobRange: Check the date of birth: the age must be between {min} and {max}.
messages.incidentFuture: The date of incident cannot be in the future.
messages.otherRequired: Describe it in the text box.
messages.narrativeLimit: The narrative is limited to {max} words. Shorten it to add more.
messages.narrativePaste: That text would make the narrative longer than {max} words, so it was not added.
messages.loadError: The form could not be loaded. Reload the page, or try again later.
messages.notEnabled: Submission is not enabled yet (test build). Your answers are kept.
messages.sessionExpiredAfter: (opens a new tab), then come back here and click Submit.
messages.submitNetwork: The request could not be sent. Check your connection and try again. Your answers are kept.
messages.submitFailed: Something went wrong and the request was not sent. Your answers are kept; please try again.
messages.submitBusy: Too many attempts. Wait a minute, then try again. Your answers are kept.
messages.submitStale: This page is out of date. Copy anything you need, then reload the page.
messages.submitTooLarge: The request is too large to send (at most 25 MB of files in total).
messages.submitUnavailable: Submissions are temporarily unavailable. Your answers are kept; please try again later.
messages.serverRejected: This value was not accepted. Check it, then submit again.

uploads.tooMany: {name} was not added: at most {max} files.
uploads.tooBig: {name} was not added: it is larger than {max} MB.
uploads.totalTooBig: {name} was not added: the files would be larger than {max} MB in total.
uploads.badType: {name} was not added: this file type is not allowed.
uploads.empty: {name} was not added: the file is empty.
uploads.duplicate: {name} was not added: it is already attached.
uploads.limitTotal: The files must be at most {max} MB in total.

review.title: Review your request
review.intro: Check every answer. Use Edit to change a section, then submit.

confirmation.title: Request received
confirmation.body: Your Legal Assistance Request was sent to VEA Legal. Keep the reference number for your records.
